name: Build the Rocket! 🚀
description:
Haul giant rocket parts with your crew, bolt them on and launch the WHOLE server to space! 🚀

💪 Lift parts, get stronger, carry heavier pieces
🤝 Team lift: grab on together to move huge boosters
🌕 Fly to the Moon, Mars and Europa, each with its own gravity
📦 Supply Drops every few minutes
✨ Find Rare, Legendary and SECRET parts for your Index

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for new planets every week!
